question: Value of (24 ÷ overline{12-4} + 32) ÷ (4 + 8 ÷ 2 - 3) is ________.
solution:
Concept used:

In such questions, the overhear bar should be solved first.

We have to follow the BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1990743799104f72f2abd6652abaa7fa2655f318b14e04461d14c46970986fe3.png] 

Calculation:

(24 ÷ overline{12-4} + 32) ÷ (4 + 8 ÷ 2 - 3)

⇒ (24 ÷ 8 + 32) ÷ (4 + 8 ÷ 2 - 3)

⇒ (3 + 32) ÷ (4 + 4 - 3)

⇒ (35) ÷ (5)

⇒ 7

**The answer is 7.**
